summary: Suncor Energy filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, reporting the voting results from its Annual General Meeting held on May 5, 2026. The meeting covered routine matters: election of ten directors, appointment of KPMG as auditors, advisory vote on executive compensation, and a shareholder proposal on climate reporting. All board members were elected with strong support, say-on-pay was approved, and the climate proposal was denied as recommended by management. No special situations such as M&A, activism, or restructuring were disclosed.
